subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should Telegram ambiguous-send recovery for this report be handled as a distinct `/reasoning stream` plus `chat.history` reliability bug, folded into broader Telegram guarded-lane recovery, or split between Telegram recovery and Control UI history backpressure?
rationale: The source evidence supports a real ambiguous-send recovery gap, but the safe behavior depends on maintainer acceptance of duplicate-send risk versus channel silence and on whether the `chat.history` burst is treated as part of this bug or separate work.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical place for the reasoning preview/final-delivery repro and any confirmed history-refresh backpressure fix.

options.title: Fold Into Telegram Recovery
options.body: Route the Telegram delivery portion through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 and preserve this issue only as linked reproduction context.

options.title: Split UI History Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and create or select a separate Control UI/Gateway item if live proof confirms `chat.history` backpressure.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical place for the reasoning preview/final-delivery repro and any confirmed history-refresh backpressure fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest current-main routing signal across the recovery guard, Telegram drain, and adapter capability lines after the recent refactor.
